# Functional-analysis frontier, cycle 19

The strongest usable primitive in families 322–332 is family 332's nonlinear
ambient median smoothing. It has an explicit finite compiler, an independently
reconstructed universal energy bound, and a newly derived sample-oracle
implementation. Family 325's complete numerical-range calculus is also
substantive, but its computational use still requires acquiring the domain,
similarity metric and power-decay certificates.

Status: original internal mathematical deductions plus two independent internal
reconstructions for family 332. No independent external validation, compiled
formal certificate, or first-in-literature claim. The source's own assertions
are separated from our deductions below.

## Coverage and provenance

Pinned release commit: `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`.
All eleven assigned families were read at overview/contents depth. Fully read
three manuscript mains and their references/README files: family 332's
*Metric Markov Cotype Two of ℓ1* (October 5, 2026), and family 325's
*The complete Crouzeix theorem* (September 23) and *A direct proof of the
complete Crouzeix inequality* (September 26). Exact Git identities and hashes
are preserved. Other family claims were not adopted from their catalogue entries.

The [family assessment](/Users/harjas/Documents/ChatGPT/Literature Digestion/results/frontier_functional/cycle19/FAMILY_ASSESSMENT.json)
records every actual depth, priority and obstruction. The
[source metadata](/Users/harjas/Documents/ChatGPT/Literature Digestion/sources/frontier_functional/cycle19/SOURCE_METADATA.json)
has 34 entries with actual SHA256 hashes, including recovered primary prior
art and targeted peer-gate snapshots. A root-derived family index is explicitly
identified as a local derivative, not an upstream release file. Failed GitHub
directory access is preserved; exact pinned raw source retrieval succeeded.
